evals.name: new-endpoint-repo-stats
evals.prompt: I need a new endpoint in the server: GET /repos/:id/stats that returns { pr_count, reviewed_pr_count, total_cost_usd } for one repo (workspace-scoped). Write the code — tell me which files you'd create or change and give me their full contents. Don't modify the repo, just put the files in the output folder mirroring server/src paths.
evals.expected_output: Thin route in modules/<m>/routes.ts, a service method, Drizzle only in a repository, a pure helper for the cost/aggregation if any, NotFoundError for a missing repo, and tests split into unit + .it.
assertions: Route handler contains no drizzle-orm / db/schema import and no container.db usage
Drizzle queries live in a repository file (repository.ts or *.repo.ts)
A service method sits between the route and the repository
Missing repo is signalled by throwing NotFoundError (not reply.status(404))
Queries are scoped by workspaceId
Proposes at least one DB-backed test named *.it.test.ts for the repository/query
No cross-module import of another module's internals (../<other-module>/)

evals.name: review-fat-labels-route
evals.prompt: Колега відкрив PR з новим модулем labels для сервера — диф у файлі inputs/labels.diff. Зроби code review з точки зору архітектури бекенду і запиши його в review.md: що не так і як це має виглядати.
evals.expected_output: Flags: drizzle in route, Octokit constructed inline instead of GitHubClient port from container, process.env instead of SecretsProvider, cross-module import of reviews/constants, reply.status for errors instead of AppError, business rule (severity threshold) inline instead of pure helper; proposes route/service/repository/helper split and GitHubClient port extension + mock.
assertions: Flags Drizzle/container.db queries inside the route handler
Flags `new Octokit` inline and asks to use the GitHubClient port from the container (extend the port + mock)
Flags process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN and points to SecretsProvider/container
Flags cross-module import from ../reviews/constants.js
Flags reply.status(404/502) error rendering and asks for AppError/NotFoundError/ExternalServiceError thrown
Asks to move the severity-threshold rule into a pure, unit-tested helper
Proposes a routes → service → repository split for the module

evals.name: design-slack-notifier
evals.prompt: we want the server to post a short summary to a Slack channel whenever a review run completes. how should i wire this into the server so it fits our architecture? give me a plan plus the key code snippets (write to plan.md in the outputs folder), don't edit the repo
evals.expected_output: Notifier port in shared adapters, Slack adapter in src/adapters, mock in adapters/mocks.ts, container getter + override using SecretsProvider, called from the review service/executor on completion, not from a route; failure isolated; tests with the mock.
assertions: Defines a Notifier-style port interface (not calling Slack directly from a service)
Puts the Slack implementation in src/adapters/<kind>/
Adds a mock implementation to src/adapters/mocks.ts (or equivalent) for tests
Wires construction in platform/container.ts with an override slot in ContainerOverrides
Reads the Slack token through SecretsProvider, not process.env
Triggers the notification from the review service/executor on run completion, not from a route handler
Notification failure does not fail the review run (isolated / logged)
